question: With Tom Brady serving his Deflategate suspension, which quarterback started New England's 2016 season opener at Arizona?
explanation: Garoppolo, in his first NFL start, led a 23-21 win over the Cardinals; rookie Jacoby Brissett later had to start while Garoppolo was hurt.

question: Ben Roethlisberger was the third quarterback taken in the first round of the 2004 draft. With which pick did Pittsburgh select him?
explanation: Eli Manning went first and Philip Rivers fourth; the Miami (Ohio) product won 13 straight starts as a rookie and two Super Bowls with the Steelers.

question: Ben Roethlisberger's shoestring tackle of Nick Harper saved Pittsburgh in the January 2006 divisional round at Indianapolis. Which Steeler had fumbled at the Colts' goal line?
explanation: Colts linebacker Gary Brackett forced the fumble, Harper scooped it up, and Pittsburgh held on to win 21-18 on its way to the title.

question: A week after trading Marshall Faulk to St. Louis in April 1999, Indianapolis used the No. 4 overall pick on which running back?
explanation: James ran for 1,553 yards as a rookie and won the NFL rushing title in both 1999 and 2000, while Faulk became an MVP with the Rams.

question: Facing 4th-and-26 late in the January 2004 divisional round against Green Bay, Donovan McNabb completed a 28-yard pass to which Eagles receiver?
explanation: The conversion kept the tying drive alive, and Philadelphia went on to win 20-17 in overtime; Todd Pinkston had caught a touchdown earlier in the fourth quarter.

question: Cleveland traded its 2008 first-round pick to Dallas to move back into the first round of the 2007 draft at No. 22. Which quarterback did it take?
explanation: The Browns also gave up the No. 36 pick to land the Notre Dame star, who had slid down the board on draft day.

question: Who was the AP Defensive Rookie of the Year for 2003?
explanation: The Ravens pass rusher had 12 sacks as a rookie and edged Dallas cornerback Terence Newman in the voting.

question: Joe Flacco redshirted in 2003 and spent 2004 as a backup at which FBS program, which refused to release him from his scholarship when he left for Delaware?
explanation: Stuck behind Tyler Palko at Pitt, Flacco had to pay his own way at Delaware, then became a first-round pick of the Ravens, 18th overall, in 2008.

question: With Andrew Luck out after shoulder surgery, which quarterback started the Colts' 2017 season opener, a 46-9 loss to the Rams?
explanation: Tolzien threw two interceptions that were returned for touchdowns and was benched; Jacoby Brissett, acquired from New England the day before the game, took over as the starter.

question: Dan Marino retired after the 1999 season holding the NFL record for career touchdown passes. How many did he throw?
explanation: Marino also retired with 61,361 passing yards, another record at the time, and both marks stood until Brett Favre passed them.
